Definition
[wedge product of symmetric endomorphisms] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0101, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0102 \group Curvature Operator Algebra For $A,B\in S^2(E)$, define an endomorphism of $\Lambda ^2E$ by \[ (A\wedge B)(v\wedge w) =\frac12\bigl(Av\wedge Bw+Bv\wedge Aw\bigr). \]
